description: Port Campbell No. 1 And No. 2 Wells Victoria Of Frome-Broken Hill Company Proprietary Limited is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Geoscience Australia Data. This publication combines the completion reports of two wells drilled at Port Campbell in the Otway Basin, Victoria, by Frome-Broken Hill Company Proprietary Limited in 1959 and 1960. Port Campbell No. 1 was located near the crest of a seismic "high". Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Geoscience Australia Data.
